title: A Multivitamin Comparison Study in Kidney Transplant Recipients.
brief_summary: This study is being done to compare arteriosclerotic cardiovascular disease in kidney transplant recipient taking a standard multivitamin versus those taking a multivitamin augmented by a high dose combination of folic acid, vitamin B12, and vitamin B6.
raw_criteria: Participants with elevated homocysteine levels that are between the ages of 35-75 years old and have had a kidney transplant with stable renal graft function.
